meta.title: For dealerships
meta.description: Put your showroom online with AutoMe: AI-written listings in Arabic and English, buyer chat with one-tap translation, test-drive bookings and your own branded storefront.

hero.title: Your showroom,
hero.subtitle: A branded storefront for your cars, listings written for you in Arabic and English, and every buyer conversation in one place.

features.title: Everything your showroom needs
features.aiBody: Upload a photo of the car and AutoMe fills in the listing. Write it in Arabic or English, and it writes the other.
features.storefrontBody: A branded page on your own subdomain, with your logo, colours and stock — ready to share.
features.chatBody: Answer buyers from one inbox. Messages translate between Arabic and English in one tap.
features.assistantBody: Buyers ask on the listing and get an answer straight away, from the car’s details and your own answers — even after hours.
features.driveBody: Buyers book within your real opening hours, and you confirm or reschedule from your dashboard.
features.teamBody: Invite your team, each with their own role. See your most-saved cars and test-drive trends, and get a weekly summary by email.

faq.title: Questions dealerships ask
faq.subtitle: Something else on your mind?
faq.trialA: Yes. The Starter plan is free: list your first cars, then move up to a paid plan when you need more listings, team members or AI.
faq.paymentA: Through Paymob, with a bank card — or a mobile wallet, when one is offered at checkout. All prices are in Egyptian pounds.
faq.changeQ: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.changeA: Yes. Change or cancel your plan any time from Billing in your dashboard.
faq.limitsQ: What happens when I reach my plan’s limits?
faq.limitsA: You are asked to upgrade before adding more — for example, another car once your plan’s listings are used up.
faq.storefrontQ: Do I get my own web address?
faq.storefrontA: Yes. Every dealership gets a storefront on its own subdomain, carrying your name, logo and colours.

cta.title: Ready when you are.
cta.description: Set up your dealership in a few minutes — or tell us what you need first.
